overview:
The City of Lakes and Rajasthan's only hill station from Delhi: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** group trip leaves Delhi in the evening in an AC deluxe vehicle and travels overnight to Udaipur.

Day 1 is the Udaipur city tour: Lake Pichola, the City Palace, Jagdish Temple and Gangaur Ghat, then the folk art performance at Bagore ki Haveli (7-8 PM) or the local flea market. Day 2 is a day trip to Mount Abu (a 4-5 hour drive) for Nakki Lake, the Dilwara Jain Temples and Mall Road, returning to Udaipur. Day 3 covers Bahubali Hills (Badi Lake), Saheliyon ki Bari and Fateh Sagar Lake before you leave by 6 PM, reaching Delhi NCR on Day 4. Prices start at ₹7,000 per person on quad sharing for regular dates and ₹10,500 for Christmas and New Year batches (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Udaipur city tour
itinerary.content:
Reach Udaipur, check in at the hotel, relax and freshen up.
Sightseeing: Lake Pichola, City Palace, Jagdish Temple and Gangaur Ghat.
Evening: the folk art performance at Bagore ki Haveli (7-8 PM) or the local flea market.
Back to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Mount Abu sightseeing
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and have breakfast.
Drive to Mount Abu (4-5 hours) and visit Nakki Lake, the Dilwara Jain Temples and Mount Abu Mall Road.
Return to Udaipur for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Fateh Sagar, Bahubali Hills | Departure
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, head out for local sightseeing.
Visit Bahubali Hills (Badi Lake), Saheliyon ki Bari and Fateh Sagar Lake, and try Udaipur's local food at the Fateh Sagar market.
Depart for Delhi NCR by 6 PM, with a halt for dinner (not included). Reach on Day 4.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Departure is in the evening from Delhi, travelling overnight to Udaipur. The final pickup point and time are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Udaipur & Mount Abu trip cost?
faqs.a: Regular dates: ₹7,000 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,500 on triple and ₹8,000 on double. Christmas and New Year batches: ₹10,500 quad, ₹11,000 triple and ₹12,000 double. 5% GST is extra.

2 nights in a hotel in Udaipur, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, all transport and sightseeing to and from Delhi NCR in an AC vehicle, a tour curator and extra floor mattresses for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How long is the drive to Mount Abu?
faqs.a: About 4-5 hours each way from Udaipur. Day 2 is the Mount Abu day trip, and you return to the same hotel in Udaipur that night.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with an advance of ₹3,000 per person by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, then clear the balance 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
If you cancel, the ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are also no refunds for any inclusion you don't use, and bookings cannot be transferred to someone else.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, good shoes, a daypack, personal medication and a small first-aid kit. The full list is under Things To Pack.
